questions.stem: Read 7 and undefined first: a tree has 7 vertices. How many edges does it have? Give the exact answer, and state the conclusion.

questions.explanation: Euler's formula gives e <= 3n-6 for a simple connected planar graph with n >= 3, so the maximum is 12. Triangle-free planar graphs have the tighter bound 2n-4.
questions.hint: Use Euler bound 3n minus 6.

questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.
questions.stem: Concerning the values 27 and undefined, a tree has 27 vertices. How many edges does it have? Give the exact answer, with the definitions in mind.
questions.explanation: Every tree on n vertices has exactly n-1 edges, here 26. Adding one more edge would create a cycle, contradicting that a tree is acyclic.
questions.hint: A tree on n vertices has n minus 1 edges.
